1.
Sri Yogesh Kumar Srivastava, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Triveni Saran Rai, learned counsel for the State are present.

2. This Criminal Misc. Bail Application under Section 439 Code of Criminal Procedure,1973 has been filed by the applicant- Lokendra Yadav Alias Beetu with the following prayers:-
"It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to enlarge the applicant on bail in connection with Case Crime No. 444 of 2023, under sections 498A, 304B, 323, 504, 506 IPC, 3/4 D.P.
